mcpb_description: Court decisions and legislation from government and court websites in over 120 jurisdictions, fetched live, with a link to the original.
mcpb_long_description: Fontes fetches court decisions and legislation live from official sources at the moment you ask, and every result links to the original. This extension is a small launcher: on first start it downloads Fontes from PyPI with uv, and afterwards keeps it up to date once a day in the background, always falling back to the last version that worked.
mcpb_tool_list_jurisdictions: List the jurisdictions covered, their sources, tools and filters.
mcpb_tool_search_caselaw: Full-text search of court decisions in one jurisdiction.
mcpb_tool_get_decision: Fetch one court decision as markdown with its source URL.
mcpb_tool_search_legislation: Find laws, acts and statutory instruments in one jurisdiction.
mcpb_tool_get_legislation_toc: Table of contents of a law with provision labels.
mcpb_tool_get_legislation_provision: Current text of one article or section.
mcpb_tool_get_legislation_text: Full consolidated text of a law, pageable.
mcpb_tool_report_bug: Prepare a Fontes bug report; sent only if the user confirms it.
app_keys_offer: Optional: free keys turn on France and raise the United States case-law limit. Add them now, or later by opening this installer again.
